notes.title: Agent Simulation is our second game
notes.content:
This is our second game, so I'm very excited. We want to share it more actively, but at an early stage. Our first goal is to update the game with your feedback. For now, the demo explains the basic principle of the game. You will play the action moments of an agent in the form of flashbacks. Since it is a very open-ended game, it is open to all kinds of new ideas. We will also accept ideas from you. The game is kind of repetitive, but we will break it as much as we can. Our current plan is that the game will be released in December, but this may change. For now, there is no htc vive support, but it will come with the first demo update. I hope you enjoy the game. If you write your thoughts, it motivates us. Thanks.

notes.title: Update Patch V1.012 - May 18
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
You will see a big change, don't be surprised, We just changed the compression format. The inventory system has changed completely. You can be sure that you will be happy. Now there is an inventory system that follows you and has a different design. I think it clear more. There have been minor changes regarding the beginning of the game. Additions have been made for new players. There is no update for the other modes, and additions will be made in the future. If you like the game, we will appreciate it if you write a review, because the Steam algorithm is reducing our traffic because we have mixed in the comments.Love indies and buy it <3 Thanks.
Other changes as listed below

[h3]Improvement[/h3]

*Added, We added flashlight to entrance of Underground city area.If you come there without flashlight, you could not pass road because of flowers.
*Improvement, Chest cover interaction improvement
*Improvement, Audio problems improved more
*Improvement, Bluestone flower is more stronger when It snap to you. You need to hit more.
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

*Fixed, BirdCage interaction was problematic, You can not hold cage anymore for easily to open cage cover.
*Fixed, Some collliders was missing.
*Fixed, Some visual glitches in levels.
*Fixed,  In some puzzle areas, it was disrupting the interaction system as both of our hands stick to the field.
*Fixed, Walking sound was broken.
[h3]Changes[/h3]

*Changed, Inventory design completedly changed, there was design issue with old version. This version is more useful. It also follow you, when you are moving.
*Changed, Grab Distance is lower now from 10 to 7.
*Changed, Drones damage power increased 2X.
*Changed, Woodman damage power increased 2X.
*Changed, Level 02 added more characters.

notes.title: Update Patch V0.178 - April 05
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
This week's update was a bit late, but a lot of things started to get more stable. In addition to the updates, we are making other improvements and additions. If a critical error is not reported, we do not plan to update for a while. We plan to release the full version of the game in the near future, with additional game modes in this version. We started to prepare them. If everything goes well, we are planning to add a few tools for you to broadcast live in the game. You can find notes about the new update below. If you played and liked it, I would appreciate it if you comment.

[h2]Improvement[/h2]

*Improved, Telekinesis box audio and effects was not good.
*Improved, Woodman have better fall down behavior now.
*Added durability time to flashlight.You need to close light if it is not needed.

[h2]Changes[/h2]

*Changed, less wave attack for little character in temple.
*Changed, Default walking speed was fast.It is slower now.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

*Fixed, When woodman run to you, sometimes they can fall down and can not get up.
*Fixed, When you drop yourself from a high place, if you hold the climbing areas while falling, you can get hurt.
*Fixed, Various bugs have been
*Fixed ,When we changed the scene with a double-handed gun, the gun was duplicated.
*Fixed, Crossbow was sometimes problematic when entering inventory.
*Fixed, Bow was sometimes problematic when entering inventory.
*Fixed, when the Giant boss flew up and summon minors, even if all the characters died, they would not land and break the game. Normally, when all the characters died, he was supposed to come down and attack.

notes.title: Update Patch V0.160 - March 19
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
This week we made sound changes on the objects. We will continue to make sound changes. One of the most important changes has been to the inventory system. Extra slot have now been added, with weapons right and left over our shoulders. You will also see two extra slots when our head is tilted down.You can now get weapons without turning the inventory on or off. I hope you enjoy this system. If you feel awkward, be sure to give us feedback. In addition, we changed and improved some textures. We added more objects around so that if you lose your weapon, you can continue to fight with the surrounding objects. We will continue to improve.

[previewyoutube=jtFcSAq4XsM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

* Change, Inventory system completely improved and we added two more slot over shoulders and around belly. When you tilt your head to down , you can see two more extra slots.
* Fixed, Haptic feedback fixed for Virtual desktop.
* Fixed, While climbing , If any interaction object touch your hand, you could fall down without reason. Interaction objects could break climbing system.
*Change, When you open menu, You needed to grab and push button. This was hard to understand. You just need to press grab button for activate.
* Change, Shovel attack power increased.
* Change, Shovel physic mechanics change a bit. If you hold shovel one hand , It moves very smooth. You should grab two hand for attack.
*Added, When you punch walls , you can hear punch sound now.
*Added, You can see percentage of the game where you are in the game. It show percentage above load slots.
*Improved, the sounds of the stick were a little disturbing.
*Improved, the sounds of the some weapons and object were a little disturbing.
*Improved, Physic objects can be more usable now.


Known Bugs:

[list]
[*] Sometimes fish area can not working right. Because fishes use physics and they can fall down weird points in the water. We are looking for correct solutions for it. If you have any problem, you can restart level.
[/list]

[list]
[*] There are few players reported that game crash in the beginning. They are all use AMD Ryzen 9 3900X or similar cpu. We will research this problem.(It is probably related with the game engine.) We could not find any solution for now.
[/list]


[list]
[*] You can lose your flower weapon ammo after load new scene. We will fix it next updates.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Patch V0.152 - March 12
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,
It is weekly updates in the game. We focused primarily on the game break bugs.We fixed small bugs and improve interactions too.

* Fixed, If you drop the cross bow you can not remote pickup unless you are in the correct angle.
* Fixed, Wizards collider problems.Add new particles around wizard (Final Boss)
* Fixed, When you use wrong sphere color in last door, It lock the sphere color and you could not open other door. (This was game break bug)
* Fixed, Mother Flower's attack distance , Sometime when you close to character , It can be wake up but not attack you.
* Fixed, You can shot Mother Flower from long distance, before woke up.
* Fixed, left hand position set correct position for Oculus Quest.
* Fixed, While you can grab or drop a weapon, you could take mistakenly blue stones or drop blue stones.
* Fixed, when your health is full , Health audio was too high and repeat every time when you touch to health.
* Fixed, When you touch arrow ammo, It was not update numbers on inventory.
* Added, more interaction objects around levels,
* Added ,more haptic feedbacks to interaction objects.


In Next Week, we will improve inventory system and polish some audios. In Inventory system, we will add three more slots over shoulder and on bell part. Some people does not like to open inventory and put a weapon there. If we add these slots, It will be more easy to organize weapons while you are fighting with enemies. Some audios are too high or low. We will try to fix them and improve them too. Thanks to playing Naau. I hope you have enjoyed the game.


Known Bugs:

[list]
[*] Sometimes fish area can not working right. Because fishes use physics and they can fall down weird points in the water. We are looking for correct solutions for it. If you have any problem, you can restart level.
[/list]
[list]
[*] There are few players reported that game crash in the beginning. They are all use AMD Ryzen 9 3900X or similar cpu. We will research this problem.(It is probably related with the game engine.) We could not find any solution for now.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Haptic feedback is still not working for Virtual desktop with Oculus Quest users. We will try to understand a bit.
[/list]
[list]
[*] You can lose your flower weapon ammo after load new scene. We will fix it next updates.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Patch V0.148 - March 05
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Thanks for playing Naau: The Lost Eye. We have new fixes on the game.I hope you will have enjoyed the game. Tell us your opinion as comment. Your comments motivate us. We will set to balance on the game. Sometimes you can be without weapon. This is our mistake in generally. We watch all videos about our game and improve the game with your comments. Some people does not like to lose the weapon but If you find any object around you that It can be your weapon. Our aim is to provide a different experience by making this situation fun in the game. Game is not shape exactly. We will shape and polish it within a few months.

* Fixed, When Shell exploded, Bumerang target is disabled.
* Fixed, In Power Station, When you hold energy bar, Sometimes hands can stuck in there.
* Fixed, You can grab fishes in the water, This could break the hand interaction system.
* Fixed, While you are moving, Bow was flicking in your hand.
* Fixed, Temple Boss designed for melee combat, It can attack from distance now, sends fireballs faster, more stronger and fixed hitbox issue.
* Fixed, Pink bombs when enter to inventory, They still can bomb inside of inventory.
* Fixed, In Mining area, If you take in minecart and you died in the tunnel, Game load in mining car. If you do not have any range weapon, You could not return back.Added extra save point near to mining car.
* Fixed, Boxes break more easy for now. We just need to hit double. There is a lot box. Breaking too many boxes was a bit boring.
* Fixed, Flower weapon was very powerfull, We changed to half of power.
* Changed, Staff is now more durable.
* Changed, Shovels can hold with two hand. It is more comfortable now.
* Added, If you drop your weapon in mining car, Weapon appear in front of mining car again.
* Added, Targeting for the boomerang should be disabled when opening the inventory.
* Added, Security check for oculus id
* Added, when you fall down while climbing, Game reposition your place to in front of stairs (Not add all scenes but will added next updates.)


Unknown Bugs:
[list]
[*] Sometimes fish area can not working right. Because fishes use physics and they can fall down weird points in the water. We are looking for correct solutions for it. If you have any problem, you can restart level.
[*] There are few players reported that game crash in the beginning. They are all use AMD Ryzen 9 3900X or similar cpu. We will research this problem.(It is probably related with the game engine.) We could not find any solution for now.
[*] There is one problem one of underground level. You need to open a door, but there are two doors that place. One of door need to two keys. If you use that key sphere first in that door, You can not sphere back. This is game break bug. You should use to open yellow light first. If you have this kind of problem, You should restart game and use correct sphere in the correct door. We will fix this problem soon.

[/list]

I hope you overall have enjoy the game.Thanks for support our early access.
Thanks.

notes.title: We are happy to announce that Naau: The Lost Eye is playable as early access
notes.content:
Hello Everyone , 

We are happy to announce that Naau: The Lost Eye is playable as early access now.

We plan to stay as early access in short period. It can be 2 or 4 months. We want to set balance of the game , The design of the game can be expanded a bit and additions can be made and we need to make more confortable for all people. We want to add more interaction objects, secret places, discovery stories about Naau's world and polish some content We want to change the some places where we don't like a little more. You can reach all story of the game. You can start and finish the game. We have designed this game as episode one. This will be first episode. If enough, the game is liked and demanded by you, we would love to make the second part of the game as an extra dlc or part 2. We will see this in the future.

There is still little bugs , In this period, We apology for it. Thanks for understanding. We would like to hear your feedback. If everything goes well, We want to add extra game modes like time trail modes, challenge arena, etc.

I hope you will have enjoy the game.

notes.title: Steam Page Update
notes.content:
Hi All,

I would like to introduce ourselves before we tell you a little about our new endeavor. We are a small indie company and who had previously developed our expertise in the animation and film industry for years at other ventures, and finally decided to take the plunge and create our very own first game. We are working on it now: Naau: The Lost Eye; and have been working on it, diligently, for over two years, with our small team. We are only 3 people (two men and one power girl) and have been focusing on this game, this experience, for many, many long hours, all the while brimming with enthusiasm, passion and loads of ideas!

[list]
[*] [b]CLIMBING:[/b] Various areas of the map will be accessible by climbing; the maps are developed to create not only visual interest with varying terrain, but also interactive, dynamic appeal.

[*] [b]WEAPONS:[/b] Certain, surprising objects that you won’t be expecting can be used as weapons! 

[*] [b]TELEKINESIS:[/b] You can telekinize objects, or move them with the power of your mind.

[*] [b]WEAPONRY:[/b] You’re going to LOVE our versions of some VERY interesting weapons like the Boomerang, Telekinesis, Magical Stick :) , Light Stones, a kind of Mace Ball, Sling , etc..

[*] [b]BOSS FIGHTS:[/b] Boss fights. YESSSSSSS!!!!
[/list]

We want to invite you to a magical, fantastic and adventure filled world in Virtual Reality; we want to invite you to an experience like none other: Naau: The Lost Eye. 





We’re hoping Naau: The Lost Eye will be released on Steam in the spring of 2020. This will be our first game and it is quite exciting for us. I hope you will thoroughly enjoy the experience. We will be sharing a teaser soon. Please stay in touch.

Add Naau: The Lost Eye to your wish list please!

If you want to ask more questions about our game, please do not hesitate. Ask in comments below, or follow us on social media on discord, twitter or Instagram. (See links immediately below).
